residualRisks: The linear qualification needs a live host attestation collected by the lead; without it the release cannot be cut, and that stays a visible blocker.
The forge adapters are the corpus's first writing provider clients: draft open only, behind the delivery's authority grant, with no token in output.
Forge write access is never verified by the setup check; it reports it as not verified, so a read-only token surfaces only at open-pr.
The tool is POSIX-only; Windows adopters get a clear refusal, not support.
In-app checks depend on adopter-supplied build, serve and check adapters; the corpus proves only their contract with its fixture page.
